name: Document Reader
tagline: Email it a photo of a receipt, invoice or form; it replies with the figures you asked for.
description:
Attach images of documents and say what you need: the total, the invoice number, the due date. It reads them with Tesseract OCR and answers from the text alone, listing anything it could not find rather than guessing.

The full text of each image is attached so you can check it.

capabilities.name: OCR
capabilities.description: Reads printed text from PNG, JPG and TIFF images, phone photos included.

capabilities.name: Field extraction
capabilities.description: Pulls the values you ask for, from several documents at once.

capabilities.name: No guessing
capabilities.description: Says when a value is not in the document.
